about: Dulcolax 5 mg (bisacodyl, a stimulant laxative) is supplied every month for nine months at two tablets nightly, and appears by brand name only. The directions record first-line treatment for chronic idiopathic constipation.

Senokot 7.5 mg (senna, a stimulant laxative) is supplied monthly for four months in the middle of a 15-month history at two tablets nightly. The directions record first-line treatment for chronic idiopathic constipation.
Senokot is supplied during oxycodone treatment. The dated condition line documents opioid-induced constipation, so the exception applies.
